name: Mjolnir_ReturningThunderHammer
description: Reworks the vanilla Frostner (MaceSilver) into Mjolnir, the returning thunder hammer. Throw it (secondary attack): it flies head-first and strikes head-first; it stays in your inventory while out. Recall it from any distance without aiming (secondary attack with empty hands or its hotbar key) - it flies straight back handle-first into your hand. No new items. Commands: mjolnir give / restyle.
